verdict.rationale: turbopuffer is an API-driven product. Its docs include an API overview covering token auth and the async `Prefer: respond-async` header, plus documented write, query, namespace-listing, metadata and recall endpoints, a Rust API client in beta, and a live llms.txt. Together these let an AI-native user drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404) and independent hands-on corroboration of API usage.
